raw_responses.Bulgarian: DESCRIPTION: Фигурата е озаглавена "Hidden State Mean" и илюстрира промените в абсолютната средна стойност на скритото състояние през различните слоеве на модел. Оста X е обозначена като "Layer" и използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 23, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y е обозначена като "Abs Mean" и също използва линейна скала с диапазон от 0 до приблизително 4.5, като етикетите са разположени през интервали от 1.0 (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). В графиката са представени три линии. Първата линия, в син цвят с пунктиран стил, представлява "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71". Тя започва от стойност близо до 0 при слой 0, леко нараства до около 0.2–0.3 в диапазона от слой 2 до слой 7, след което остава относително стабилна около 0.2 до слой 10. От слой 10 нататък линията започва постепенно да нараства, достигайки около 0.5 при слой 15 и около 0.9 при слой 18. След слой 20 се наблюдава рязко нарастване, като стойността достига приблизително 2.6 при слой 21 и след кратък спад отново се покачва до около 2.5 при слой 23. Втората линия, в оранжев цвят с точков (пунктиран) стил, представлява "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05". Тя остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон на слоевете, с минимални колебания, и достига стойности едва забележимо над 0 в последните слоеве. Третата линия, в зелен цвят с плътен стил, представлява "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04". Тя също остава много близо до 0 през целия диапазон, като леко нараства до приблизително 0.1 в последните слоеве (около слой 22–23). Оранжевата и зелената линия визуално се припокриват в голяма част от графиката поради близките си стойности. Легендата е разположена в горния ляв ъгъл на графиката.
raw_responses.Chinese: DESCRIPTION: This figure, titled "Hidden State Mean," displays the absolute mean of hidden states across network layers for three different conditions. The x-axis represents "Layer," scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 23, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Abs Mean," scaled linearly from 0 to approximately 4.5, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.5. Three lines are plotted. The first is a blue dashed line representing "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," which starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.25 near layers 3–5, remains relatively flat around 0.2–0.3 through layers 5–10, then begins increasing more steeply from approximately 0.3 at layer 10 to about 0.5 at layer 15, continuing upward to roughly 0.9 at layer 18, then rising sharply to approximately 2.1 at layer 20, dipping slightly near layer 21, and reaching approximately 2.6 at layer 23. The second is an orange dotted line representing "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," which remains very close to 0 throughout all layers, showing only a very slight increase toward the final layers, reaching approximately 0.1 by layer 23. The third is a green solid line representing "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," which similarly stays very close to 0 across all layers, with a marginal increase near the end, reaching roughly 0.08 by layer 23. The orange and green lines are nearly overlapping and remain close to the x-axis throughout the entire range of layers.
raw_responses.English: DESCRIPTION: This plot illustrates the absolute mean of hidden states across layers of a neural network, comparing values before and after a gating mechanism as well as a baseline. The x-axis represents "Layer" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 23, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis represents "Abs Mean" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to approximately 4.5, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5 or 1.0. The first line, shown in blue with a dashed line style and no markers, represents the hidden state mean before the gate (with a reported average of 0.71); it starts near 0.05 at layer 0, rises slightly to around 0.2–0.3 in layers 2–7, remains relatively flat around 0.2–0.3 through layer 10, then increases more steeply from approximately 0.4 at layer 12 to about 0.5 at layer 17, before rising sharply to approximately 2.6 at layer 21 and reaching around 2.5 at layer 23. The second line, shown in orange with a dotted line style, represents the hidden state mean after the gate (with a reported average of 0.05); it remains very close to 0 across all layers, with only a very slight increase toward the final layers reaching approximately 0.05–0.1. The third line, shown in green with a solid line style, represents the hidden state mean of the baseline (with a reported average of 0.04); it similarly stays very close to 0 throughout all layers, with a slight upward trend near the final layers reaching approximately 0.1 at layer 23.
raw_responses.German: DESCRIPTION: Das Diagramm mit dem Titel „Hidden State Mean" zeigt den absoluten Mittelwert der verborgenen Zustände über verschiedene Schichten eines Modells für drei verschiedene Bedingungen. Die x-Achse ist mit „Layer" beschriftet, hat eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis etwa 23, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 5 (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Die y-Achse ist mit „Abs Mean" beschriftet, hat ebenfalls eine lineare Skala und reicht von 0 bis etwa 4,5, mit Tick-Beschriftungen in Intervallen von 0,5 (0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5). Die erste Linie, dargestellt in Blau mit gestricheltem Linienstil und ohne sichtbare Marker, repräsentiert „hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71"; sie beginnt bei Layer 0 nahe 0, steigt leicht auf etwa 0,2–0,3 bei Layer 5, bleibt relativ stabil bis etwa Layer 10, steigt dann allmählich auf etwa 0,5 bei Layer 15 und zeigt ab Layer 18 einen starken Anstieg mit einem markanten Sprung auf etwa 2,6 bei Layer 21 und erreicht etwa 4,4 bei Layer 23. Die zweite Linie, dargestellt in Orange mit gepunktetem Linienstil, repräsentiert „hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05"; sie verläuft nahezu konstant nahe 0 über alle Schichten hinweg, mit nur minimalen Schwankungen, und endet bei Layer 23 bei einem Wert nahe 0,1. Die dritte Linie, dargestellt in Grün mit durchgezogenem Linienstil, repräsentiert „hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04"; sie verläuft ebenfalls nahezu konstant nahe 0 über alle Schichten und endet bei Layer 23 bei einem Wert von etwa 0,1.
